scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build && cd ../web-ui && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ai,agent,coding-agent,web-ui,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,red,green,magenta" "cd packages/ai && npm run dev" "cd packages/agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/coding-agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/web-ui && npm run dev" "cd packages/tui && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:tsc: concurrently --names "ai,web-ui" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "cd packages/ai && npm run dev:tsc" "cd packages/web-ui && npm run dev:tsc"
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke && cd packages/web-ui && npm run check
scripts.version:major: node -e "console.error(\"Mupt releases do not use major bumps; use npm run version:mupt -- <version> if needed.\"); process.exit(1)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish:npm: npm run publish:ai && npm run publish:agent && npm run publish:coding-agent
scripts.publish:npm:dry: npm run publish:ai:dry && npm run publish:agent:dry && npm run publish:coding-agent:dry
scripts.release:major: node -e "console.error(\"Mupt releases do not use major bumps.\"); process.exit(1)"
